I answered Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

The source is a message in #north-team itself, which Marcus can see. On Aug 20, 2025, Dana posted that Thea had reported the door 6 duplicates again on the morning shift. The same trailer was logged twice, once from the kiosk check-in and once when dispatch added the driver by hand. I also told Marcus that Dana owns the account and was following up on it.

Something that could cause confusion: a September 2025 note mentions two appointments stacked against door 6 at Brackenwater Freight Co., which is Marcus's account. That's a different customer, so I left it out of the reply.
